(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][ZeroPower][NightOfHundredBandit]";

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

damageTintColor: 0xffffff,

damageTintPulseInMs: 0,

damageTintPulseHoldMs: 0,

damageTintPulseOutMs: 0,

damageTintPulseIntervalMs: 0,

// Helpers

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

  ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

    const { local = true, world = false } = options;

    if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

function resolveTokenEntry(entry) {

  if (!entry) return null;

  if (entry?.object) return entry.object;

  if (entry?.center && entry?.document) return entry;

  if (typeof entry === "string") {

    const doc = fromUuidSync?.(entry);

    if (doc?.object) return doc.object;

    if (doc?.center && doc?.document) return doc;

    if (doc?.documentName === "Actor") {

      return doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

      return doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

    const sceneTok = canvas.tokens?.get?.(entry);

    if (sceneTok) return sceneTok;

  }

  return null;

}

function resolveSourceToken() {

  const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

  const candidates = [

    p?.sourceToken,

    p?.casterToken,

    p?.token,

    p?._sourceToken,

    p?.meta?.sourceToken,

    p?.meta?.casterToken,

    p?.action?.sourceToken,

    p?.action?.casterToken,

    p?.sourceTokenUuid,

    p?.casterTokenUuid,

    p?.tokenUuid,

    p?.tokenUUID,

    p?.attackerUuid,

    p?.attackerUUID,

    p?.meta?.attackerUuid,

    p?.meta?.attackerUUID,

    p?.actionContext?.meta?.attackerUuid,

    p?.actionContext?.meta?.attackerUUID,

    p?.actionContext?.sourceTokenUuid,

    p?.actionContext?.casterTokenUuid

  ].filter(Boolean);

  for (const c of candidates) {

    const tok = resolveTokenEntry(c);

    if (tok) return tok;

  }

  return null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

  const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

  const out = [];

  if (Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) {

    for (const entry of globalThis.__TARGETS) {

      const tok = resolveTokenEntry(entry);

      if (tok) out.push(tok);

    }

  }

  const arrs = [

    p?.targets,

    p?.targetTokens,

    p?.meta?.targets,

    p?.meta?.targetTokens,

    p?.targetTokenUuids,

    p?.originalTargetUUIDs,

    p?.targetTokenIds,

    p?.actionContext?.targets,

    p?.actionContext?.targetTokenUuids,

    p?.actionContext?.originalTargetUUIDs

  ].filter(a => Array.isArray(a));

  for (const arr of arrs) {

    for (const entry of arr) {

      const tok = resolveTokenEntry(entry);

      if (tok) out.push(tok);

    }

  }

  const seen = new Set();

  return out.filter(tok => {

    const key = tok?.document?.uuid ?? tok?.id;

    if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;

    seen.add(key);

    return true;

  });

}

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs = 15000) {

  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    let settled = false;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {

      if (settled) return;

      settled = true;

      Hooks.off(hookName, handler);

      console.warn(TAG, "Timed out waiting for hook", hookName);

      resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true });

    }, timeoutMs);

    const handler = (data) => {

      if (settled) return;

      settled = true;

      clearTimeout(timer);

      Hooks.off(hookName, handler);

      resolve(data ?? { ok: true });

    };

    Hooks.on(hookName, handler);

  });

}

const sourceToken = resolveSourceToken();

const targets = resolveTargets();

if (!sourceToken) {

  ui.notifications.warn("Night of Hundred Bandit: no caster token found in action payload.");

  return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

  ui.notifications.warn("Night of Hundred Bandit: no target tokens found in action payload.");

  return;

}

if (!game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

  ui.notifications.error("Night of Hundred Bandit: ONI Pseudo API not found.");

  return;

}

const cutinUrl =

  foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken.actor, CUTIN_PROP_PATH) ??

  sourceToken.actor?.img ??

  "";

const doneHook = `${ANIM_KEY}.done.${randomID()}`;

const payloadForEmit = {

  type: ANIM_KEY,

  sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

  targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

  sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

  timestamp: Date.now()

};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Pseudo script

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

const cfg = Object.assign({

  damageShakeYMode: "bounce",

  damageTintColor: 0xff0000,

}, params.cfg ?? {});

const loadTex = globalThis.loadTextureSafe ?? loadTexture;

const stage = canvas.stage;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Number(ms) || 0));

const clamp = (n, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n));

const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

const randi = (a, b) => Math.floor(rand(a, b + 1));

const choose = (arr) => Array.isArray(arr) && arr.length ? arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)] : null;

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

let endStarted = false;

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(payload = { ok: true }) {

  if (doneFired) return;

  doneFired = true;

  Hooks.callAll(params.doneHook, payload);

}

function isDisplayAlive(obj) {

  return !!obj && !obj.destroyed && !!obj.position;

}

function safeRemove(obj) {

  try { if (obj?.parent) obj.parent.removeChild(obj); } catch (_) {}

}

function safeDestroy(obj) {

  try { obj?.destroy?.(); } catch (_) {}

}

function addStageChild(obj, z) {

  stage.sortableChildren = true;

  obj.zIndex = Number(z) || 0;

  stage.addChild(obj);

  stage.sortChildren();

  return obj;

}

function destroyObj(obj) {

  safeRemove(obj);

  safeDestroy(obj);

}

function playLocalAudio(src, { volume = 0.5, loop = false, rate = 1.0 } = {}) {

  try {

    const a = new Audio(src);

    a.preload = "auto";

    a.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(volume) || 0));

    a.loop = !!loop;

    a.playbackRate = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(4.0, Number(rate) || 1));

    a.play().catch(() => {});

    return a;

  } catch (_) {

    return null;

  }

}

async function fadeOutAudio(audio, ms = 300) {

  if (!audio) return;

  const startVol = Number(audio.volume ?? 0);

  const steps = 10;

  const stepMs = Math.max(10, Math.floor(ms / steps));

  for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {

    try { audio.volume = startVol * (1 - i / steps); } catch (_) {}

    await waitMs(stepMs);

  }

  try { audio.pause(); } catch (_) {}

  try { audio.currentTime = 0; } catch (_) {}

  try { audio.src = ""; } catch (_) {}

}

function tweenValue(onUpdate, from, to, durMs, easeFn = easeInOutCubic) {

  return new Promise(resolve => {

    const start = performance.now();

    const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

    const duration = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);

    const update = () => {

      const raw = (performance.now() - start) / duration;

      const t = clamp(raw, 0, 1);

      const e = easeFn(t);

      try {

        onUpdate(lerp(from, to, e), t, e);

      } catch (err) {

        console.warn("[ONI][Pseudo][NightOfHundredBandit] tweenValue aborted", err);

        ticker.remove(update);

        resolve(false);

        return;

      }

      if (t >= 1) {

        ticker.remove(update);

        resolve(true);

      }

    };

    ticker.add(update);

  });

}

function fadeAlpha(obj, from, to, durMs, easeFn = easeOutCubic) {

  if (!isDisplayAlive(obj)) return Promise.resolve(false);

  obj.alpha = from;

  return tweenValue((v) => {

    if (!isDisplayAlive(obj)) throw new Error("fadeAlpha target destroyed");

    obj.alpha = v;

  }, from, to, durMs, easeFn);

}

function tweenXY(obj, fromX, toX, fromY, toY, durMs, easeFn = easeInOutCubic, onStep = null) {

  if (!isDisplayAlive(obj)) return Promise.resolve(false);

  return new Promise(resolve => {

    const start = performance.now();

    const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

    const duration = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);

    const update = () => {

      const raw = (performance.now() - start) / duration;

      const t = clamp(raw, 0, 1);

      const e = easeFn(t);

      try {

        if (!isDisplayAlive(obj)) throw new Error("tweenXY target destroyed");

        obj.x = lerp(fromX, toX, e);

        obj.y = lerp(fromY, toY, e);

        try { onStep?.({ t, e, raw }); } catch (_) {}

      } catch (err) {

        console.warn("[ONI][Pseudo][NightOfHundredBandit] tweenXY aborted", err);

        ticker.remove(update);

        resolve(false);

        return;

      }

      if (t >= 1) {

        ticker.remove(update);

        resolve(true);

      }

    };

    ticker.add(update);

  });

}

async function makeImageSprite(url, zIndex = 3000) {

  const tex = await loadTex(url);

  const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

  sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

  addStageChild(sprite, zIndex);

  return sprite;

}

async function createCasterClone(token) {

  const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

  const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTex(token.document.texture.src);

  const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

  sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

  sprite.x = token.center.x;

  sprite.y = token.center.y;

  if (baseObj) {

    sprite.width = baseObj.width;

    sprite.height = baseObj.height;

    sprite.angle = baseObj.angle ?? 0;

    sprite.scale.x = baseObj.scale?.x ?? sprite.scale.x;

    sprite.scale.y = baseObj.scale?.y ?? sprite.scale.y;

  }

  const texScaleX = token.document.texture?.scaleX ?? 1;

  const texScaleY = token.document.texture?.scaleY ?? 1;

  sprite.scale.x *= Math.sign(texScaleX || 1);

  sprite.scale.y *= Math.sign(texScaleY || 1);

  addStageChild(sprite, Number(cfg.zCaster ?? 3500));

  return sprite;

}

function waitFrames(count = 1) {

  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    let remaining = Math.max(1, Number(count) || 1);

    const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

    const step = () => {

      remaining -= 1;

      if (remaining <= 0) {

        ticker.remove(step);

        resolve();

      }

    };

    ticker.add(step);

  });

}

function colorToRgb(hex) {

  const n = Number(hex) >>> 0;

  return {

    r: (n >> 16) & 255,

    g: (n >> 8) & 255,

    b: n & 255

  };

}

function rgbToColor(r, g, b) {

  const rr = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(r)));

  const gg = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(g)));

  const bb = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(b)));

  return (rr << 16) | (gg << 8) | bb;

}

function mixColor(fromHex, toHex, t) {

  const a = colorToRgb(fromHex);

  const b = colorToRgb(toHex);

  return rgbToColor(

    lerp(a.r, b.r, t),

    lerp(a.g, b.g, t),

    lerp(a.b, b.b, t)

  );

}

function animateForDuration(durationMs, onFrame) {

  if (durationMs <= 0) {

    onFrame({ elapsedMs: 0, elapsedSec: 0, t: 1 });

    return Promise.resolve();

  }

  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    const start = performance.now();

    const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

    const tick = () => {

      const elapsedMs = performance.now() - start;

      const t = clamp(elapsedMs / durationMs, 0, 1);

      try {

        onFrame({

          elapsedMs,

          elapsedSec: elapsedMs / 1000,

          t

        });

      } catch (err) {

        console.warn("[ONI][Pseudo][NightOfHundredBandit] animateForDuration aborted", err);

        ticker.remove(tick);

        resolve(false);

        return;

      }

      if (t >= 1) {

        ticker.remove(tick);

        resolve(true);

      }

    };

    ticker.add(tick);

  });

}

async function createTargetFeedbackClone(token) {

  const baseObj = token?.mesh ?? token?.icon;

  if (!token || !baseObj) return null;

  const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTex(token.document.texture.src);

  const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

  sprite.anchor.set(

    Number(baseObj.anchor?.x ?? 0.5),

    Number(baseObj.anchor?.y ?? 0.5)

  );

  sprite.x = token.center.x;

  sprite.y = token.center.y;

  sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

  sprite.angle = baseObj.angle ?? 0;

  sprite.blendMode = baseObj.blendMode ?? PIXI.BLEND_MODES.NORMAL;

  const w = Math.abs(baseObj.width ?? token.w ?? 64);

  const h = Math.abs(baseObj.height ?? token.h ?? 64);

  const scaleBoost = Number(cfg.damageFeedbackScaleBoost ?? 1.0);

  sprite.width = w * scaleBoost;

  sprite.height = h * scaleBoost;

  if ((baseObj.scale?.x ?? 1) < 0) sprite.scale.x *= -1;

  if ((baseObj.scale?.y ?? 1) < 0) sprite.scale.y *= -1;

  sprite.tint = Number(baseObj.tint ?? 0xFFFFFF);

  addStageChild(sprite, Number(cfg.damageFeedbackZ ?? 3390));

  return {

    token,

    baseObj,

    sprite,

    homeX: sprite.x,

    homeY: sprite.y,

    originalBaseVisible: baseObj.visible ?? true,

    originalBaseTint: Number(baseObj.tint ?? 0xFFFFFF),

    phaseX: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,

    phaseY: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2

  };

    }

    await beginFinish();

  }

} catch (err) {

  console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][NightOfHundredBandit]", err);

  try { await fadeOutAudio(crowdAudio, Number(cfg.crowdFadeOutMs ?? 350)); } catch (_) {}

  crowdAudio = null;

  stopManagedImpactAudios();

  await cleanupTargetFeedback(targetFeedbackEntries);

  targetFeedbackEntries = [];

  cleanupSpawned([whiteOverlay]);

  try {

    if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

    casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

  } catch (_) {}

  try {

    if (whiteOverlay) {

      destroyObj(whiteOverlay);

      whiteOverlay = null;

    }

  } catch (_) {}

  fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err?.message || err) });

} finally {

  try { await fadeOutAudio(crowdAudio, Number(cfg.crowdFadeOutMs ?? 350)); } catch (_) {}

  crowdAudio = null;

  stopManagedImpactAudios();

  await cleanupTargetFeedback(targetFeedbackEntries);

  targetFeedbackEntries = [];

  try {

    if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

    if (whiteOverlay) {

      destroyObj(whiteOverlay);

      whiteOverlay = null;

    }

  } catch (_) {}

}

`;

try {

  ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", payloadForEmit, { local: true, world: false });

  const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

  await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

    scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

    scriptSource,

    casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

    targetTokenUuids: targets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

      finalBanditUrl: FINAL_BANDIT_URL,

      finalBanditTripSfx: FINAL_BANDIT_TRIP_SFX,

      finalBanditFootstepSfx: FINAL_BANDIT_FOOTSTEP_SFX,

      banditUrls: BANDIT_URLS,

      cutinUrl,

      cutinSfx: CFG.cutinSfx,

      cfg: CFG

    },

  });

  const result = await waitDone;

    console.warn(TAG, "Pseudo animation reported non-OK result", result);

} catch (err) {

  console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed", err);

} finally {

  ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

    ...payloadForEmit,

    timestamp: Date.now()

  }, { local: true, world: false });

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][NightOfHundredBandit]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

const DAMAGE_X = 10; // tuning knob

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const targetCount = Math.max(1, targetUuids.length);

// Count IP from ALL visible creature tokens in the scene

const countedTokens = (canvas?.tokens?.placeables ?? []).filter(tok => {

return !!tok?.actor && tok?.document?.hidden !== true;

});

let totalSceneIp = 0;

for (const tok of countedTokens) {

const ip = Number(tok?.actor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? 0) || 0;

totalSceneIp += Math.max(0, ip);

}

const bonusDamage = Math.floor((totalSceneIp * DAMAGE_X) / targetCount);

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + bonusDamage;

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.nightHundredBandit = {

damageX: DAMAGE_X,

totalSceneIp,

targetCount,

computedBonusDamage: bonusDamage,

countedTokens: countedTokens.map(t => ({

name: t.name,

uuid: t.document?.uuid ?? "",

ip: Number(t?.actor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? 0) || 0

}))

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

totalSceneIp,

targetCount,

damageX: DAMAGE_X,

bonusDamage,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});
props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][NightOfHundredBandit]";

const visibleTokens = (canvas?.tokens?.placeables ?? []).filter(tok => {

return !!tok?.actor && tok?.document?.hidden !== true;

});

let updated = 0;

const rows = [];

for (const tok of visibleTokens) {

const actor = tok.actor;

if (!actor) continue;

const beforeIp = Number(actor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? 0) || 0;

try {

await actor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": 0

});

updated += 1;

rows.push({

name: actor.name,

token: tok.name,

beforeIp,

afterIp: 0

});

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to zero IP", {

actor: actor?.name,

token: tok?.name,

err

});

}

}

console.log(TAG, "RESOLVED", {

updated,

rows

});
